appDescription: Business vehicle logbook that records every trip from the odometer and prepares the National Tax Service mileage log.

function.name: CLASSIFY_LAST_TRIP
function.description: Records the most recently finished trip as business, commute, or personal use, with an optional short note about the visit.

category.description: Purpose of the trip: business, commute, or personal.

note.description: Optional short note about where the driver went or why, kept in the user's language.

function.name: ADD_TRIP_NOTE
function.description: Adds a short note to the most recently finished trip without changing its purpose.

note.description: Short note about the trip, kept in the user's language.

function.name: GET_MONTHLY_LOGBOOK_SUMMARY
function.description: Reports this month's number of trips, total distance, business-use distance, business-use ratio, and trips still waiting for a purpose.
